suggestions.topic: Python AsyncIO Event Loop Deep Dive
suggestions.rationale: Developers frequently struggle with asynchronous programming mental models, searching for how the single-threaded event loop actually schedules coroutines without blocking. Addressing this clears massive friction points and drives high watch-time completion.
